# Raja Mantri Chor Sipahi (RMCS)
> Digital multiplayer recreation of the traditional Indian social deduction board game.

## Overview
Raja Mantri Chor Sipahi (King, Minister, Thief, Soldier) is a 4-player social deduction parlor game originated in India. Players are secretly dealt chits for four roles:
- Raja (King): Receives 1,000 points automatically.
- Mantri (Minister): Tasked with deducing which of the remaining two players is the Sipahi and which is the Chor. If correct, awards 500 points; if wrong, awards 0 points.
- Sipahi (Soldier): Receives 300 points regardless of deduction outcome.
- Chor (Thief): Receives 0 points if caught by the Mantri, or 500 stolen points if the Mantri guesses incorrectly.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Socket.io-client.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Socket.io, MongoDB, OpenAI LLM integration for bot persona behavior.
- Hosting & Compliance: Responsive Single Page Application, DPDP Act 2023 compliant data governance, zero tracking pixels.
